description: Hand-labeled ground truth over the Olist demo DB. ambiguous=true means the question should NOT be confidently answered as-is (a good copilot clarifies, declines, or flags low confidence); ambiguous=false are clear controls that should be answered. Drives clarification precision/recall and the trap confidently-wrong eval; seeds the Phase 5 gallery. category groups trap types; dimension names the clarification dimension where one applies.
